mapper.select: SELECT m.feedback AS feedback, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM t_message m INNER JOIN t_conversation c ON m.conversation_id = c.conversation_id WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.deleted = 0 AND m.feedback IS NOT NULL AND m.feedback != '' AND m.created_at >= #{from} AND m.created_at <= #{to} GROUP BY m.feedback ORDER BY cnt DESC
